entity_policy.name: strict-reference-entities-v2
entity_policy.number: Explicit cardinal, ordinal, fraction, percentage, numeric identifier, clock time or order-of-magnitude quantity. Exclude indefinite articles, discourse markers and non-quantitative one-of expressions.
entity_policy.date: Explicit calendar year, decade, century, named month/day or calendar date; relative yesterday/today/last week excluded.
entity_policy.amount: Currency amount including written currency name or symbol; not separately counted as number.
entity_policy.spelled_sequence: Explicit dictated sequence of letters; ordinary acronyms and abbreviations alone do not establish a spelling task.
entity_policy.comparison: Case-sensitive; preserve punctuation/digits/spelling; ignore whitespace only; no semantic equivalences or WER normalization.
